parsed.why: Enforceable drag-performance criminal ban, birth-sex facility and shelter rules, prison placement by birth sex, indecent-exposure statute covering bathroom use, no gender-identity hate-crime coverage, documented official indifference. Own hostile layer far below parent.

Only a K-12 student facility restriction; no statewide adult bathroom rule, no drag ban, no documented trans violence. Hate-crime gap and surgery-based certificate rule are resident-facing. Sits modestly above parent.

Misdemeanour for trans bathroom/locker use where a minor is present, extended K-12 facility ban, X-marker rescinded, no gender-identity hate-crime or civil remedy, ranked 'worst policies in effect'. Narrower than dossier 1 or 4.

Unique law criminalising restroom/changing-room use by birth sex in government buildings and private businesses including hospitals, up to a year per offence — inescapable universal exposure; enjoined narrowing unresolved. Lowest of the five.

No statewide adult facility ban or adult care ban; pressure sits with appointed boards and one school district. No gender-identity hate-crime or state nondiscrimination coverage, but no criminal exposure for adults. Above parent.
